_meta.forward_indicators_note: v3 adds forward-looking indicators to each REIT: distribution_frequency (+source), forecast_dpu_cents (+basis/source), rental_reversion_pct (+source), pct_debt_due_12m (+source), dpu_change_per_100bps_pct (+source), dpu_yoy_pct (+source), and a per-REIT _forward_notes caveat block. All values sourced from primary issuer/SGX disclosures (PDFs extracted via pipeline/extract_pdf.cjs). Nulls used where the figure is not disclosed in primary sources (never fabricated), each with an explanatory note. KEY NULLS: rental_reversion null for BTOU (not disclosed), ODBU/MXNU (N/A - net-lease/government-let portfolios with contractual escalations, not market reversion), UD1U (not disclosed); dpu_change_per_100bps null for all except MXNU (-4.7% full-repricing scenario is the only cleanly-disclosed MAS-style DPU sensitivity) - most managers disclose only an ICR sensitivity, and CLCT discloses a currency-split DPU sensitivity rather than a single +100bps figure; pct_debt_due_12m null for CMOU/BTOU/UD1U/CY6U (maturity profiles graphic or not given as a single %); forecast_dpu null where no numeric guidance (CMOU, OXMU, ODBU, UD1U, AU8U, CY6U) and 0 for BTOU (distributions SUSPENDED). dpu_yoy null for ODBU/MXNU (FY2024 DPU not corroborated in primary sources located) and BTOU (suspended). CY6U ICR re-verification documented in CY6U.icr_check_note: 2.8x confirmed as the manager's stated HEADLINE 1Q 2026 ICR (no inconsistency).
_meta.notes: Refreshed 2026-10-26 to each REIT's latest published results/business update. Periods: CMOU 1H 2026 (28 Jul 2026); BTOU 1H 2026 (6 Aug 2026, SGXNet copies - investor.manulifeusreit.sg returns HTTP 403 from this environment); OXMU 1H 2026 (12 Aug 2026) + loan-extension announcements 19/20 Oct 2026; ODBU 1H 2026 (13 Aug 2026) + BJ's Quincy divestment completed 16 Sep 2026; MXNU 1H 2026 (7 Aug 2026); UD1U 1H 2026 (5 Aug 2026) + BVG Berlin lease 7 Sep 2026; SEB 1H 2026 (13 Aug 2026) + proposed internalisation 28 Sep 2026; AU8U 3Q 2026 business update (23 Oct 2026) with DPU/NAV from 1H 2026 results (5 Aug 2026); CY6U 1H 2026 (29 Jul 2026). Pending after this refresh: MXNU 3Q update ~2 Nov, CY6U 3Q 28 Oct, ODBU 3Q 13 Nov 2026; KORE/Prime/Manulife 3Q updates not yet published. dpu_ttm_cents is a true trailing 12 months (2H 2025 + 1H 2026) in the distribution currency (USD cents / GBP pence / EUR cents / SGD cents). ICR = MAS CIS-Code ICR including perpetual distributions where applicable. Corrections vs prior revision: SEB DOES have EUR64.2m perpetual securities (prior said none) and distributes semi-annually (frequency corrected 4->2); AU8U perp-inclusive gearing recomputed (prior 42.0% understated the add-back); AU8U report_pr_url previously pointed to a CLINT file. ALERTS: BTOU distributions still suspended, MAS ICR 1.6x, gearing 54.1% (>50%), MRA exit targeted end-2026; OXMU ICR 1.6x and US$550m facilities only short-term extended to 15 Dec 2026 pending refinancing (FS net current liabilities, going-concern reliance on refinancing); UD1U ICR fell to 1.8x (from 2.7x), gearing 45.5%, 1H DPU -47.9% YoY; CY6U NAV -11% to S$1.23 on INR weakness. Computed fields (property yield, perp-inclusive gearing, some geographic splits, YoY %) are labelled as computed in their notes. Nulls carry *_note explanations; no values taken from aggregators.

CMOU.name: KORE US REIT (Keppel Pacific Oak US REIT)
CMOU.wace_note: Average Cost of Debt 4.74% p.a. as at 30 Jun 2026 (excludes amortisation of upfront debt costs); All-in Average Cost of Debt 4.91% p.a.
CMOU.dpu_ttm_note: True TTM = 2H 2025 DPU 0.25 US cents + 1H 2026 DPU 0.40 US cents = 0.65 US cents (period 1 Jul 2025 - 30 Jun 2026). 1H 2026 payout ratio ~21%.
CMOU.dpu_last_period_note: 1H 2026 DPU 0.40 US cents (1 Jan - 30 Jun 2026; ex-date 4 Aug 2026, paid 29 Sep 2026). KORE distributes half-yearly.
CMOU.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per unit US$0.70 as at 30 June 2026 (Unitholders' Funds US$729.739M / 1,044.450M units), vs US$0.68 at 31 Dec 2025. Unit price US$0.182 as at 30 June 2026.
CMOU.wale_basis: by CRI (cash rental income) as at 30 Jun 2026; by NLA = 4.0 years per Top-10 tenant slide (note: lease-expiry slide footnote states 3.8 years by NLA - internal inconsistency in the deck)
CMOU.num_properties_note: 13 freehold office buildings and business campuses across 8 key US growth markets as at 30 June 2026
CMOU.aum_note: Portfolio value US$1,325.4M (31 December 2025 appraisals; no revaluation at 1H 2026). NLA approx. 4.8 million sq ft.
CMOU.top10_tenant_basis: by CRI (cash rental income) as at 30 Jun 2026; by NLA = 24.6%
CMOU.geographic_split_basis: % of Net Property Income 1H 2026 (excludes one-off operating income); 100% United States
CMOU.forward_dpu_guidance: Distribution quantum for 2H 2026 (1 Jul - 31 Dec 2026) expected to remain consistent with 1H 2026 (0.40 US cents), subject to market/financing conditions and interest rates; Manager anticipates progressively increasing payout ratio (1H 2026 ~21%) towards a sustainable level. Targets FY2026 year-end occupancy broadly in line with end-2025 (87.2%). Evaluating selective divestments with proceeds possibly applied to debt reduction.
CMOU.property_yield_note: Computed: TTM NPI (FY2025 NPI US$80.656M - 1H 2025 NPI US$40.656M + 1H 2026 NPI US$43.134M = US$83.134M) / portfolio value US$1,325.4M (31 Dec 2025 valuation) = 6.27%. Manager does not disclose an NPI yield / cap rate.
CMOU.perpetual_securities_note: KORE US REIT has no perpetual securities outstanding (1H 2026 balance sheet: Unitholders' Funds US$729.739M, no perpetual capital line); perp-inclusive gearing = headline 43.3%.
CMOU.forecast_dpu_basis: 2H 2026 DPU expected to remain consistent with 1H 2026 DPU of 0.40 US cents (manager guidance on distribution quantum, subject to prevailing market and financing conditions and interest rate movements). Implied FY2026 DPU ~0.80 US cents if guidance holds. Value is the guided next half-year DPU, not a full-year figure.
CMOU.rental_reversion_note: Portfolio rental reversion +1.5% for both 2Q 2026 and 1H 2026. Built-in average rental escalation 2.6% p.a. Record 1H leasing of 550,522 sf (11.5% of NLA).
CMOU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Not disclosed as a 12-month percentage. Debt maturity profile (as at 30 Jun 2026) shows 2.3% due in 2026 (uncommitted RCF) and 34.8% due in 2027 (incl. 4.2% uncommitted RCF); no term-loan maturities remaining in 2026, manager engaging lenders on early refinancing of 2027 facilities. The share falling due by 30 Jun 2027 cannot be isolated from the calendar-year chart. WADM only 1.7 years - refinancing watch item.
CMOU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: MAS-style DPU sensitivity not disclosed. Disclosed: ICR falls to 2.1x (from 2.5x) on +100bps weighted average interest rate and to 2.2x on -10% EBITDA; every +/-50bps SOFR = approx. -/+US$1.38M income available for distribution p.a. (floating debt 41.8%). DPU % not derivable because payout ratio (~21%) is set at manager discretion.
CMOU.dpu_yoy_note: Not meaningful: 1H 2025 DPU was nil (distributions suspended 2H 2023 - 1H 2025 under Recapitalisation Plan), so 1H 2026 0.40 US cents vs 1H 2025 0 is N.M. (as stated by the manager). Income available for distribution rose 2.1% YoY to US$20.4M.
CMOU._forward_notes: Distribution currency USD. Distributions resumed 2H 2025 (0.25c) and 1H 2026 (0.40c, ~21% payout); 2H 2026 guided flat at similar quantum. TTM DPU 0.65 US cents. Gearing 43.3%, ICR 2.5x (MAS CIS Code basis; no perps so adjusted = headline). Short WADM 1.7 years with ~35% of debt maturing in 2027 - refinancing is the key risk. 3Q 2026 business update not yet released as at 26 Oct 2026.

BTOU.name: Manulife US REIT (MUST)
BTOU.report_note: 1H 2026 unaudited results broadcast on SGXNet 6 Aug 2026 (ref SG260806OTHRZMTK; attachments: unaudited financial results, media release, presentation, supplemental data). The investor.manulifeusreit.sg IR site returns HTTP 403 (Akamai) from this environment, so all sources are the SGXNet-hosted copies on links.sgx.com. No 3Q 2026 operational update located as at 26 Oct 2026.
BTOU.gearing_note: Aggregate leverage 54.1% as at 30 Jun 2026 (gross borrowings / total assets), down ~400bps from 58.0% at 31 Mar 2026 after Figueroa sale proceeds repaid debt. Still above the 50% MAS limit (manager notes limit not considered breached as due to circumstances beyond its control; waiver obtained for Acquisition Mandate). Unencumbered gearing covenant 59.7% (limit relaxed to 80% to 30 Jun 2026, reverted to 60% from 1 Jul 2026).
BTOU.icr_note: MAS ICR (12-month trailing) 1.6x as at 30 Jun 2026 (1.7x at 31 Mar 2026); 1.9x excluding Sponsor-Lender loan exit premium. Bank ICR (facility definition) 2.0x vs relaxed covenant floor 1.5x until 31 Dec 2026. MAS sensitivities: 1.5x on -10% EBITDA, 1.4x on +100bps. BELOW the MAS 1.8x threshold requiring corrective-action disclosure. No perpetual securities, so MAS adjusted ICR = stated ICR.
BTOU.wace_note: Weighted average interest rate 5.84% as at 30 Jun 2026 (4.52% at 31 Mar 2026), excluding Sponsor-Lender loan exit premium; 6.61% including the exit premium. Jump driven by expiry of a US$250m interest rate swap in Apr 2026.
BTOU.wadm_note: Weighted average debt maturity 2.0 years as at 30 Jun 2026 (2.1 years at 31 Mar 2026).
BTOU.dpu_ttm_note: Distributions remain SUSPENDED (halted since 2023). No DPU declared for 2H 2025 or 1H 2026; TTM = 0. Lenders require half-yearly distributions to stay suspended until the later of achieving the Reinstatement Conditions and the end of the Bank ICR relaxation period (31 Dec 2026). 1H 2026 distributable income per unit (not paid) was 0.66 US cents.
BTOU.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per unit US$0.19 as at 30 June 2026 (net assets attributable to unitholders US$345.066M / 1,835.124M units); unchanged vs 31 Dec 2025. Unit price US$0.052 at 30 Jun 2026 (~0.27x P/NAV).
BTOU.occupancy_note: Portfolio occupancy 70.4% as at 30 Jun 2026 (67.6% at 1Q 2026). Increase is mechanical - Figueroa (~45% occupied) was sold in Jun 2026; Centerpointe tenant returned ~70k sq ft early (Centerpointe now 55.3%, Diablo 37.8%).
BTOU.wale_basis: Portfolio WALE as at 30 Jun 2026 (basis not specified on summary slide; property-level WALE given by NLA). Top-10 tenants WALE 4.8 yrs by NLA / 4.6 yrs by GRI.
BTOU.num_properties_note: 6 freehold office properties (Michelson-Irvine CA, Exchange-Jersey City NJ, Penn-Washington DC, Phipps-Atlanta GA, Centerpointe-Virginia, Diablo-Tempe AZ) as at 30 Jun 2026, NLA 2.8m sq ft; Figueroa (Los Angeles) divestment completed Jun 2026 for US$92.5m.
BTOU.aum_note: Investment properties US$817.646M as at 30 Jun 2026 (6 properties at 31 Dec 2025 appraisal values, sum US$815.7M per property table). Total assets US$898.8M.
BTOU.top10_tenant_basis: by GRI (gross rental income) as at 30 Jun 2026
BTOU.geographic_split_note: Computed by % of property value (31 Dec 2025 appraisals of the 6 remaining properties: Michelson 230.4, Phipps 192.5, Exchange 191.4, Penn 79.8, Centerpointe 76.7, Diablo 44.9; total US$815.7M). Manager does not publish a geographic % chart. 100% United States.
BTOU.forward_dpu_guidance: Distributions remain suspended. Minimum Sale Target (US$328.7m) under the MRA exceeded after the Figueroa sale; manager targets exiting the MRA by end-2026 (subject to lender negotiations) and then to 'initiate distributions at a sustainable payout ratio'. No quantitative DPU guidance. Growth and Value Up Plan (approved 16 Dec 2025) allows acquisitions of US/Canadian industrial, living and retail assets.
BTOU.property_yield_note: Computed: 1H 2026 same-store NPI (excl. Figueroa) US$22.8M x 2 = US$45.6M annualised / value of 6 remaining properties US$815.7M = 5.59%. A true TTM NPI on the current portfolio is not disclosed (reported 1H 2026 NPI US$23.1M includes Figueroa until its Jun 2026 sale). Manager does not disclose a cap rate.
BTOU.perpetual_securities_note: Manulife US REIT has NO perpetual securities outstanding (1H 2026 balance sheet shows only unitholders' funds; borrowings consist of trust-level term loans and the US$137.0m Sponsor-Lender loan). Perp-inclusive gearing therefore equals headline 54.1%; field left null as there are no perps to add back.
BTOU.distribution_frequency_note: Half-yearly when paid; currently SUSPENDED under the MRA.
BTOU.forecast_dpu_basis: Distributions SUSPENDED; lenders require suspension until the later of meeting Reinstatement Conditions and the Bank ICR relaxation period (to 31 Dec 2026). No DPU forecast; 0 reflects the affirmatively-disclosed suspension. Resumption only after MRA exit (targeted end-2026, subject to lenders).
BTOU.rental_reversion_note: 1H 2026 rent reversion +0.3% on 141k sq ft of leases executed (5.0% of NLA), vs -10.0% in 1H 2025 (excludes divested properties).
BTOU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: No debt due in 2026 (fully repaid from Figueroa proceeds); ~US$133.4m (~27% of ~US$486.6m loans) due in calendar 2027. The portion due by 30 Jun 2027 is not disclosed, so a 12-month % cannot be isolated.
BTOU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Not meaningful - distributions suspended. Disclosed: every +50bps SOFR reduces annual distributable income by ~US$1.6m; MAS ICR falls to 1.4x on +100bps.
BTOU.dpu_yoy_note: Not meaningful: DPU 0 in both 1H 2026 and 1H 2025 (suspended). Distributable income per unit (not paid) fell 21.4% YoY to 0.66 US cents.
BTOU._forward_notes: CRITICAL: distributions SUSPENDED; ICR 1.6x is below the MAS 1.8x corrective-action threshold and near the 1.5x floor; gearing 54.1% remains above the 50% MAS cap (permitted only because breach due to circumstances beyond manager's control). Hedge ratio dropped to 34.3% after US$250m swap expiry (Apr 2026), pushing weighted average interest rate to 5.84% (6.61% incl. exit premium). Positives: Minimum Sale Target exceeded, 2026 maturities fully repaid, MRA exit targeted end-2026. Unit price US$0.052 vs NAV US$0.19. Bank ICR relaxation (1.5x) expires 31 Dec 2026 - key event.

OXMU.name: Prime US REIT (PRIME)
OXMU.wace_note: Weighted average interest rate 5.5% p.a. for 1H 2026 (excludes amortisation of debt-related transaction costs).
OXMU.pct_fixed_debt_note: Not disclosed in 1H 2026 materials. Interest rate swaps expired in June 2026 (FS note on derivative assets), so the 1Q 2026 figure of 66% fixed/hedged (50% of which hedged only until 2026) is no longer valid; the remaining fixed/hedged share as at 30 Jun 2026 is not stated.
OXMU.wadm_note: Not disclosed as a single figure. Maturity profile (fully extended terms, 30 Jun 2026): US$67m 2026, US$489m 2027, US$105m 2029. Per 20 Oct 2026 announcement the US$550m credit facilities and US$66.95m Sorrento loan have been short-term extended to 15 Dec 2026 and 19 Dec 2026 pending a longer-term refinancing.
OXMU.dpu_ttm_note: True TTM = 2H 2025 DPU 0.49 US cents + 1H 2026 DPU 0.50 US cents = 0.99 US cents (1 Jul 2025 - 30 Jun 2026). Payout ratio 65% since 6 Oct 2025.
OXMU.dpu_last_period_note: 1H 2026 DPU 0.50 US cents (vs 0.12 in 1H 2025 and 0.49 in 2H 2025); distribution paid/payable US$7.2m. Half-yearly distributions.
OXMU.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per Unit US$0.53 as at 30 June 2026 (net assets US$755.228M / 1,437.458M units), unchanged vs 31 Dec 2025. Unit price US$0.161 at 30 Jun 2026 (70% discount to NAV).
OXMU.occupancy_note: Committed occupancy 84.1% as at 30 June 2026 (31 Mar 2026: 83.1%); fifth consecutive quarter of growth. ~492k sf (11.7% of committed occupancy) signed but not yet commenced.
OXMU.wale_basis: Weighted Average Lease Expiry computed for all committed leases (from later of commencement date or 30 Jun 2026)
OXMU.num_properties_note: 13 Class A freehold office properties in 12 key U.S. office markets; NLA 4.2 million sq ft
OXMU.aum_note: Portfolio carrying value US$1.4 billion as at 30 June 2026 (independent valuations US$1,399.6M as at 31 Dec 2025; no mid-year revaluation).
OXMU.top10_tenant_basis: by CRI (annualised cash rental income, commenced leases, June 2026); WALE Top 10 = 2.9 years
OXMU.geographic_split_basis: % of CRI by Primary Market as at 30 June 2026 (labels verified against rendered pie chart); 100% United States
OXMU.forward_dpu_guidance: Manager expects to maintain payout ratio at no less than 65% going forward; ~492k sf of committed leases (11.7% of committed occupancy) to commence rent on a staggered basis mostly from 3Q 2026, expected to lift cash property income. Refinancing: US$550m credit facilities and US$66.95m loan extended to 15/19 Dec 2026 while a longer-term financing is completed (20 Oct 2026).
OXMU.property_yield_note: Computed: TTM NPI (2H 2025 US$33.4M + 1H 2026 US$33.4M = US$66.8M) / portfolio value US$1,399.6M (31 Dec 2025 valuations) = 4.77%. Manager does not disclose a portfolio cap rate.
OXMU.perpetual_securities_note: Prime US REIT has no perpetual securities (1H 2026 balance sheet: borrowings are bank loans only; net assets US$755.2M all attributable to unitholders). Perp-inclusive gearing = headline 44.9%.
OXMU.forecast_dpu_basis: No numeric DPU forecast. Manager guides payout ratio of no less than 65% and rising cash income as ~492k sf of signed leases commence from 3Q 2026; 2H 2026 outcome also depends on refinancing terms of the facilities now maturing Dec 2026.
OXMU.rental_reversion_note: 2Q 2026 rental reversion +6.2% (1Q 2026: +4.0%) on ~90k sf of leasing. Almost all leases carry 2-3% annual escalations.
OXMU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Not reliably determinable. 1H 2026 FS classify only US$66.95M (~10.1% of US$661.4M gross loans) as repayable within one year as at 30 Jun 2026 (group in net current liability position of US$81.1M; going-concern basis relies on refinancing being completed). However, per SGX announcements of 22 Jul, 19 Oct and 20 Oct 2026, the US$550m credit facilities have been repeatedly short-term extended (now to 15 Dec 2026) and the US$66.95m Sorrento loan to 19 Dec 2026 - i.e. the large majority of borrowings is currently contractually due within ~2 months pending a longer-term refinancing. The exact drawn amount under the US$550m facilities is not separately stated, so no single % is given.
OXMU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: MAS-style DPU sensitivity not disclosed; only ICR sensitivities (1.4x on +100bps all loans; 1.5x on +100bps floating loans only). Swaps expired Jun 2026, so rate exposure increased.
OXMU.dpu_yoy_note: Computed: 1H 2026 DPU 0.50 vs 1H 2025 DPU 0.12 US cents = +316.7%, driven almost entirely by payout ratio rising from 10% to 65%; distributable income actually FELL to US$11.1M from US$16.7M (-33.5%).
OXMU._forward_notes: Distribution currency USD, half-yearly. TTM DPU 0.99 US cents. KEY RISK: refinancing - US$550m facilities and US$66.95m loan only short-term extended to mid-Dec 2026 (third extension; 20 Oct 2026 announcement) while longer-term financing is sought; FS show net current liabilities and going-concern reliance on refinancing. ICR 1.6x (<1.8x MAS threshold), swaps expired Jun 2026. Positive: occupancy up 5 straight quarters to 84.1%, +6.2% reversion, 492k sf signed-not-commenced. DPU rise is payout-driven (distributable income -33.5% YoY).
OXMU.icr_note: ICR 1.6x (trailing 12 months to 30 Jun 2026) per Property Funds Appendix of the CIS Code; no perpetual securities so MAS adjusted ICR = stated ICR. Sensitivities: 1.4x on -10% EBITDA, 1.4x on +100bps. Below MAS 1.8x corrective-action threshold.

ODBU.name: United Hampshire US REIT (UHREIT)
ODBU.gearing_note: Aggregate Leverage 40.4% as at 30 Jun 2026; Net Aggregate Leverage 39.7% (total borrowings less cash / total deposited property less cash). Post-period: BJ's Quincy divested 16 Sep 2026 for US$34.0M (net proceeds ~US$33.3M may repay debt) - not reflected.
ODBU.icr_note: Trailing 12-month ICR 2.4x per Appendix 6 of the MAS CIS Code (no perpetual securities, so adjusted ICR = stated). Sensitivities: 2.2x on -10% EBITDA; 2.0x on +100bps.
ODBU.wace_note: Weighted Average Interest Rate 4.89% (trailing 12-month, excludes upfront debt-related transaction costs); 5th consecutive period of decline.
ODBU.pct_fixed_debt_note: 71.5% fixed-rate loans (incl. floating loans swapped to fixed); 28.5% floating-rate loan and revolver drawn unhedged.
ODBU.wadm_note: Weighted Average Debt Maturity 2.9 years as at 30 Jun 2026 (assuming loan extension options fully exercised).
ODBU.dpu_ttm_note: True TTM = 2H 2025 DPU 2.30 + 1H 2026 DPU 2.16 = 4.46 US cents (manager states 2H 2025 + 1H 2026 total distribution of 4.46 US cents; 2H 2025 derived as FY2025 4.39 - 1H 2025 2.09).
ODBU.dpu_last_period_note: 1H 2026 DPU 2.16 US cents (+3.4% YoY vs 2.09). Half-yearly distributions; DRP applied.
ODBU.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per unit US$0.73 as at 30 June 2026 (Adjusted NAV excl. distribution US$0.71); net assets US$446.277M / 608.180M units. Unit price US$0.515 at 30 Jun 2026 (29% discount to NAV).
ODBU.occupancy_note: Grocery & Necessity committed occupancy 97.6% as at 30 Jun 2026; Self-Storage occupancy 93.5% (+430bps).
ODBU.wale_basis: Based on gross rental income of Grocery & Necessity Properties for the month of June 2026
ODBU.num_properties_note: 23 properties as at 30 Jun 2026 (21 Grocery & Necessity + 2 Self-Storage); BJ's Quincy (Grocery & Necessity) divestment completed 16 Sep 2026 for US$34.0M, leaving 22 (20 G&N + 2 Self-Storage).
ODBU.aum_note: Total portfolio value US$798.5 million (carrying value of investment properties as at 30 Jun 2026, per appendix; balance sheet investment properties US$817.8M incl. other items). NLA 3.7 million sq ft. BJ's Quincy (book ~US$33.7M) sold 16 Sep 2026 - not reflected.
ODBU.top10_tenant_note: Sum of disclosed Top 10 percentages (10.3+10.1+7.9+5.2+3.8+3.7+2.8+2.8+2.7+2.7) based on GRI of Grocery & Necessity Properties for June 2026. Tenants providing essential services = 58.5% of GRI. WALE of Top 10 = 10.5 years. Top-10 includes BJ's (since divested at Quincy).
ODBU.geographic_split_note: 100% U.S. East Coast - New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Maryland, Virginia, North Carolina, Florida, Massachusetts, Connecticut. % by state not disclosed in 1H 2026 materials.
ODBU.forward_dpu_guidance: No quantitative DPU guidance. Manager focused on leasing, disciplined capital recycling (BJ's Quincy sold Sep 2026 at 4.9% above valuation) and prudent growth; no refinancing requirement until February 2028; weighted average interest rate declining.
ODBU.property_yield_note: Computed: 1H 2026 NPI US$25.5M annualised (x2) = US$51.0M / investment properties US$817.8M as at 30 Jun 2026 = 6.24%. TTM NPI not computable from 1H 2026 materials (2H 2025 NPI not restated). Manager does not disclose a cap rate.
ODBU.perpetual_securities_note: UHREIT has no perpetual securities (1H 2026 balance sheet: loans and borrowings US$327.2M; net assets attributable to unitholders only). Perp-inclusive gearing = headline 40.4%. Note 'Perpetual (Asia) Limited' is the trustee, not a perpetual security.
ODBU.forecast_dpu_basis: No quantitative forward DPU forecast. 1H 2026 DPU 2.16 US cents (+3.4% YoY); TTM 4.46 US cents.
ODBU.rental_reversion_note: Not disclosed as a portfolio rental-reversion percentage. Long-WALE (7.9 yrs) triple-net grocery-anchored leases with built-in escalations; 260k+ sq ft of new and renewal leases signed in 1H 2026 and tenant retention 90%, but no reversion % published.
ODBU.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Manager states no refinancing requirement until February 2028. The fully-extended maturity chart shows a ~US$41M mortgage loan maturing in 2026 that is pre-funded by a committed delayed-draw term loan ('Refinancing by delayed-draw term loan'), so 0% requires refinancing within 12 months; on a strict contractual basis ~US$41M (~12.5% of US$327M borrowings) matures in 2026 but is already refinanced.
ODBU.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Computed from manager disclosure: every 50bps movement in SOFR = 0.079 US cents DPU p.a. = 1.77% of TTM DPU (based on 28.5% unhedged floating debt). Linear doubling for +100bps = -0.158 US cents = -3.54% of TTM DPU.
ODBU.dpu_yoy_note: 1H 2026 DPU 2.16 vs 1H 2025 2.09 US cents = +3.4% YoY (manager-stated). FY2025 4.39 US cents.
ODBU._forward_notes: Distribution currency USD, half-yearly. Defensive: grocery-anchored necessity retail + self-storage; 97.6% G&N occupancy, 7.9-yr WALE, ICR 2.4x, no refinancing until Feb 2028, falling cost of debt. Post-period: BJ's Quincy sold 16 Sep 2026 (US$34.0M, 4.9% above valuation). 3Q 2026 operational update scheduled 13 Nov 2026.

MXNU.name: Elite UK REIT
MXNU.gearing_note: Aggregate Leverage per Property Funds Appendix 34.8% as at 30 Jun 2026 (42.8% at 31 Dec 2025). Manager's headline Net Gearing (debt less cash / assets less cash) 34.6%. Expected to trend towards 35-40% target as acquisition debt for five new properties (completed Aug 2026) is drawn.
MXNU.wace_note: Borrowing cost 4.7% as at 30 Jun 2026 (unchanged from 31 Dec 2025).
MXNU.pct_fixed_debt_note: 99% of borrowings on fixed rates as at 30 Jun 2026 (85% at 31 Dec 2025).

CY6U.name: CapitaLand India Trust (CLINT)
CY6U._notes: CY6U is a BUSINESS TRUST listed on SGX, not a REIT. CLINT is structured as a registered business trust under the Singapore Business Trusts Act (Cap. 31A), with CapitaLand India Trust Management Pte. Ltd. as Trustee-Manager. While colloquially referred to as a REIT and treated similarly for screening purposes, it is governed under business-trust rules rather than the Code on Collective Investment Schemes / Property Funds Appendix. This affects: (i) MAS aggregate-leverage and ICR rules do not directly apply (the manager elects to comply on a voluntary basis), (ii) the trust can undertake direct property development without the 10% development limit applicable to REITs, and (iii) tax transparency at the trust level may differ. Composite screening thresholds should be applied with this distinction in mind.
CY6U.gearing_note: Gearing 38.0% as at 30 Jun 2026 (35.7% at 31 Mar 2026; 39.6% at 31 Dec 2025): effective borrowings (incl. hedging derivatives, deferred consideration and proportionate JV debt; S$1,695m) / value of Trust properties. CY6U.nav_per_unit_note: NAV per unit S$1.23 (INR 92.93) as at 30 Jun 2026, DOWN from S$1.38 at 31 Dec 2025 (INR depreciation, enlarged unit base of 1,486.9m after Feb 2026 placement). Illustrative NAV excl. deferred tax on FV gains S$1.43 (INR 107.80).
CY6U.occupancy_note: Committed portfolio occupancy 91% as at 30 Jun 2026 (excludes Logistics Park and Data Centres). ITPB 92% (large lease expiry, backfilling underway); ITPP-H 88%; aVance II Pune 59%.
CY6U.wale_basis: Weighted Average Lease Expiry 3.2 years; Weighted Average Lease Term 6.4 years (by base rent; excludes Logistics Park and Data Centres)
CY6U.num_properties_note: Single property count not stated. Portfolio: IT parks in Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune and Mumbai, industrial facilities, logistics park (Chennai) and CapitaLand DC Navi Mumbai Tower 1 (50 MW, fully leased to a hyperscaler, handed over 1H 2026); six forward-purchase assets under development (6.4m sq ft). CyberPearl and CyberVale divested 3Q 2025.
CY6U.aum_note: Assets under management S$3.5bn as at 30 Jun 2026 per press release (S$3.8bn / INR 266.4bn valuation at 31 Dec 2025 at S$1:INR70.4 - SGD decline reflects INR depreciation). Interest-bearing forward-purchase receivables S$417.9m.
CY6U.top10_tenant_basis: Top 10 IT Parks tenants by Portfolio Base Rent as at 30 Jun 2026 (TCS 8%, Applied Materials 7%, Infosys 4%, UnitedHealth 3%, Amazon 3%, Synechron 3%, BMS 2%, Capital One 2%, Societe Generale 2%, Deloitte 2%). Separately, Data Centres/Industrial: leading hyperscaler >5%, Pegatron 2%.
CY6U.geographic_split_basis: % of base rent by city (city totals of the Lease Expiry Profile by Base Rent table as at 30 Jun 2026; excludes Logistics Park and Data Centres). 100% India.
CY6U.forward_dpu_guidance: No quantitative DPU guidance. Distribution policy 90% of income available for distribution. Onshore INR term loan drawn Jul 2026 (INR5.5bn) expected to give 1.6% DPU accretion on FY2025 DPU basis; full income from DC Navi Mumbai T1 from Aug 2026; forward-purchase pipeline (aVance 5 and aVance A1 Hyderabad completed). INR/SGD translation remains the key swing factor.
CY6U.property_yield_note: Computed: TTM NPI (2H 2025 S$111.3m + 1H 2026 S$107.5m = S$218.8m) / AUM S$3.5bn (30 Jun 2026) = 6.25%. AUM figure may include non-property items; manager does not publish a cap rate.
CY6U.perpetual_securities_note: CLINT has S$101.4m perpetual securities (balance sheet 30 Jun 2026; S$100m issued FY2025), treated as equity in the 38.0% gearing. Computed incl. perps: (S$1,695m effective borrowings + S$101.4m) / implied Trust property value (~S$4,461m = 1,695/0.38) = 40.3%. ICR 2.9x already includes perp distributions (3.0x excl.).
CY6U.distribution_frequency_note: Semi-annual: distributions for the six-month periods ending 30 June and 31 December. (A 1.44-cent ADVANCE distribution for 1 Jan to 4 Mar 2026 was made due to the Feb 2026 private placement - that is a one-off advance, not a change to the semi-annual cadence.)
CY6U.forecast_dpu_basis: No quantitative forward DPU forecast. Manager cites +1.6% DPU accretion (vs FY2025 DPU 7.87c) from the Jul 2026 onshore INR loan; INR depreciation continues to erode SGD DPU.
CY6U.rental_reversion_note: Portfolio rental reversion +24% TTM (Jul 2025 - Jun 2026) on 72 eligible transactions (~1.85m sq ft); city-level figures shown on slide (Pune slightly negative) but labels not unambiguous in extracted text, so not recorded. Excludes Logistics Park and Data Centres.
CY6U.pct_debt_due_12m_note: Calendar/FY2026 bucket used as proxy: S$252.8m of S$1,695m effective borrowings (14.9%) mature in FY2026 (incl. S$152.7m short-term revolving credit facilities) per maturity profile as at 30 Jun 2026; FY2027 adds S$315.4m (18.6%), part of which falls within 12 months, so true 12-month share is higher. Bar labels read from chart text.
CY6U.dpu_change_per_100bps_note: Not disclosed; only ICR sensitivity (2.6x on +100bps). 74.5% fixed-rate.
CY6U.dpu_yoy_note: Computed: 1H 2026 DPU 4.00 vs 1H 2025 3.97 S cents = +0.8% (manager rounds to +1%); +13% in INR terms. Distributable income +8% in SGD.
CY6U.icr_check_note: Re-verified against 1H 2026 results (29 Jul 2026): ICR 2.9x as at 30 Jun 2026 is the manager headline and already includes distributions on perpetual securities (3.0x excluding them), i.e. consistent with the MAS adjusted-ICR definition.
CY6U._forward_notes: Business trust (not a REIT); DPU in SGD on INR assets. TTM DPU 7.90 S cents. Gearing back up to 38.0% (40.3% incl. perps), ICR 2.9x (adjusted). NAV fell 11% to S$1.23 on INR weakness. Strong operating metrics (+24% reversion, 91% occupancy). 3Q 2026 business update due 28 Oct 2026 (after this refresh).
